description: Enhance Admin Dashboard Water Utility and Power Utility tabs with prominent utility interruption scheduling UI. Add 'Upcoming Interruptions' sections, 'Schedule New' forms with date/time pickers, past interruptions collapsible views, and color-coded status badges. Also add prominent 'KT' (KloudTech) branding to the live sensor widget on Admin Overview tab. This feature is independent of FEAT-003 and improves admin workflow for managing utility outages that citizens will see on their dashboard.
steps: Open src/screens/AdminDashboard.jsx in editor and locate WaterUtilityTab function (line 5485)

Add 'Upcoming Interruptions' section at top of WaterUtilityTab with Droplet icon (Lucide), query water_interruptions table filtered by status='ongoing', display in table with columns: Date, Time, Provider, Affected Barangays, Duration (hours), Households Affected, Status badge (blue theme)

Add 'Schedule New Interruption' button with blue accent, opens form modal with fields: interruption_date (date input), interruption_time (time input), provider (dropdown: 'Palayan City Water District' or 'Balibago Waterworks'), affected_barangays (text input), cause (dropdown: pipe_burst, maintenance, shortage, pump_failure, other), duration_hours (number input), households_affected (number input), description (textarea)
Add 'Past Interruptions' collapsible section at bottom of WaterUtilityTab filtered by status='restored', same table format as upcoming

Locate PowerUtilityTab function (line 5825) and add 'Upcoming Outages' section with Zap icon (Lucide), query power_interruptions table filtered by interruption_date >= today, display in table with columns: Date, Feeders Affected, Households, Total Duration (minutes), Peak Outage Time, Cause, Status badge (yellow theme)

Add 'Schedule New Outage' button with yellow accent, opens form modal with fields: interruption_date (date input), total_outages (number input), total_affected_households (number input), feeders_affected (text input), total_duration_minutes (number input), peak_outage_time (time input), cause (dropdown: line_fault, transformer_issue, weather, maintenance, overload, other), restoration_status (dropdown: ongoing, restored, partial), description (textarea)
Add 'Past Outages' collapsible section at bottom of PowerUtilityTab for historical records
Locate OverviewTab function (line 721) and find KloudTech sensor widget (lines 796-918), add large 'KT' badge in top-left corner with brand styling (white text on accent background, bold font)
Add status badge color coding: ongoing (orange #f97316), restored (green #10b981), partial (yellow #eab308)
Use global modal system (showSuccessModal, showErrorModal, showConfirmModal) for all CRUD feedback
Test in dev mode: npm run dev, login as admin, navigate to Water Utility tab, create new interruption with date 2025-01-05 10:00, confirm it appears in Upcoming list
Repeat test for Power Utility tab, verify form validation (required fields), verify status badge colors
Run npm run build and confirm 0 errors
acceptance_criteria: WaterUtilityTab has 'Upcoming Interruptions' section with table view displaying ongoing water interruptions (blue Droplet icon theme)
PowerUtilityTab has 'Upcoming Outages' section with table view displaying upcoming power outages (yellow Zap icon theme)
Both tabs have 'Schedule New' buttons that open form modals with all required fields (date, time, affected areas, duration, cause, description)
Forms validate required fields before submission and show error messages for missing data
Interruptions display in chronological order (soonest first) in Upcoming sections
Status badges are color-coded: ongoing (orange), restored (green), partial (yellow)
Past interruptions sections are collapsible to reduce clutter and default to collapsed state
KloudTech sensor widget on Admin Overview tab has prominent 'KT' badge in top-left corner with white text on accent background
All CRUD operations (create, update, delete) use global modal system (showSuccessModal on success, showErrorModal on failure, showConfirmModal for deletes)
Build passes with 0 errors: npm run build completes successfully
verification: npm run build (must complete with 0 errors)
npm run dev, login as admin user, navigate to Water Utility tab in AdminDashboard

Click 'Schedule New Interruption', fill form with date=2025-01-05, time=10:00, provider='Palayan City Water District', affected_barangays='Singalat, Atate', cause='maintenance', duration_hours=4, households_affected=150, description='Scheduled pipe replacement', submit and confirm success modal appears
Verify new interruption appears in 'Upcoming Interruptions' table with blue status badge showing 'ongoing'
Navigate to Power Utility tab, repeat test with power outage form, verify yellow theme and correct fields
Navigate to Overview tab, verify KloudTech sensor widget has 'KT' badge visible in top-left corner
No console errors in browser DevTools during testing
